buyer: Owner or front-desk lead at a 1-8 groomer shop

steps.name: Capture pet and service needs
steps.action: Collect breed, weight, coat, behavior, allergies, accommodations, and requested service
steps.gate: Groomer reviews allergies, behavior, and accommodation limits

steps.name: Prepare quote and waiver
steps.action: Apply service-duration rules and stage policy acknowledgment
steps.output: Draft quote, duration, and waiver handoff
steps.gate: Groomer approves price, duration, and suitability

steps.name: Stage the deposit
steps.action: Prepare disabled deposit payload and cancellation terms
steps.gate: No live charge from this starter

steps.name: Reserve the right slot
steps.trigger: External deposit receipt or approved exception
steps.action: Match duration, groomer skill, cleanup buffer, and capacity

steps.name: Queue care and rebook
steps.action: Prepare coat-care note and interval-based rebooking task
steps.gate: No customer message sends from this starter
